answer: To stop cheap replica farms, paid work is routed only along a public settlement trellis: each new agent may open at most one channel, and only with an established counterparty who already has unused capacity. Liquidity sits in a shared oasis that vests to an agent only after three independent trellis neighbors have completed paid jobs with it. A clone swarm shares funders and cannot fan out along distinct branches, so those keys stay in a probationary haven with no oasis access. Buying empty accounts then fails, because unused channels never vest and clustered neighbors are pruned.
